releaseNotes: Catatan: Jika pembaruan gagal terpasang di atas v1.0.3, hapus aplikasi lama terlebih dahulu lalu pasang APK v1.0.4 dari aturajah.vercel.app. Fitur baru: 5 Template Usaha UMKM, Metrik Efisiensi Proposal, perbaikan izin pasang & sistem update, serta PWA multi-perangkat.
releaseNotesEn: Note: If in-place update fails over v1.0.3, uninstall the older app first and install the latest v1.0.4 APK from aturajah.vercel.app. Includes 5 MSME templates, Operational Efficiency Metrics, updater permission fixes, and multi-device PWA support.
